# Virtual Gears repository instructions

## Always audit documentation

Treat documentation and release copy as part of every product change. Whenever
behavior, compatibility, naming, setup, safety, hardware support or release
status changes, review every relevant surface before considering the work
complete:

- `README.md`
- the GitHub Pages sources under `docs/` and the `mkdocs.yml` navigation
- `docs/APP_STORE.md` and the matching live App Store Connect metadata
- screenshots, diagrams, captions and alternative text
- privacy and safety documentation
- `DEVELOPMENT.md` and recorded hardware evidence

Keep the message and terminology consistent across those surfaces. Update all
affected copies in the same change, remove stale claims, and distinguish
physically validated behavior from compatibility that is only expected.
